title: Chief Martial Law Administrator Order 1979 No 71

sections.shortTitle: Chief Martial Law Administrator Order 1979 No 71
sections.section: ORDER - Chief Martial Law Administrator Order 1979, No. 71
sections.description:
MARTIAL LAW ORDERS
MARTIAL LAW ORDERS
By
CHIEF MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 1st October 1979]
No. 71
In Martial Law Order No. 17, in
paragraph 2, in sub-paragraph (1) before the proviso added vide Martial Law
Order No. 60, the following explanation shall be inserted and shall be deemed
to have always been so inserted, namely :-
"Explanation.-For the
purposes of this Martial Law Order the expression `Inquiry Officer' shall
include a Court of Inquiry' held under the provisions of Pakistan Army, Act,
1952 (Act No. XXXIX of 1952) and the Rules made thereunder, and also a
`Commission of Inquiry' appointed under the provisions of Martial Law Order No.
19."
